markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (98%)** · Confident · Careful review
Simulated frozen section with suggested positive margins [F7], severity-3 blur, and zero neighbor agreement.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 98%, InSitu 2% [F1] | Strong invasive call; ECE 5% |
| Conformal set | Invasive (alpha 10%) | Single class; 90% coverage |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliable, 96% OOD [F6] | Unflagged, atypical (AUROC 70%) |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree (true) | Foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 0/5 Invasive [F5] | Normal/Benign neighbors contradict call |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 9) · context · Below-typical TIL score; descriptive only [F2] · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 5) · ↑ invasive · Scarce duct confinement pushes toward invasive [F3] · Weak
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 6) · ↑ invasive · Scarce tubules push toward invasive; caption inconsistent [F4] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · Low score pushes toward invasive (0/20 check) · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 4) · ↑ invasive · Elevated stromal infiltration supports invasive call · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top 3 risk regions drops risk beyond random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (+0.0008, 95% CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); uses unreliable normal lobules and mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 frozen-section blur obscures benign ducts or mimics stromal invasion at 96% OOD.
- All five nearest neighbors are Normal/Benign; top match BACH_0170 differs in unreliable normal lobules (0/20).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 4, 1, 8, 2**: Highest risk (94%–100%) and invasion signal; confirm true stromal infiltration.
2. **Regions 4, 8, 9, 11**: Inspect inferior (323 um), medial (215 um), lateral (108 um) margins.
3. **Regions 5, 6, 9**: Verify duct confinement, tubules, and lymphocytes where top concept scores peak.
